name: Entity Browser Multi Widget
description: Multiple native Entity Browser launchers sharing one selection target.
project_description: Entity Browser Multi Widget adds a single field widget, 'Entity browser (multi)', for entity reference fields. It lets a site builder place more than one native Entity Browser launcher on one field: each enabled browser renders its own launcher button, but all of them write into the same hidden selection target, so editors get several browse/upload flows (for example a media library, a document browser, and an existing-content view) that all contribute to one selection list. Launchers are enabled and ordered in the widget's own settings form via a sortable drag-and-drop table; the first enabled launcher is styled as the primary button. The widget extends Entity Browser's stock EntityReferenceBrowserWidget, so it inherits all of its options (field widget display, edit/remove/replace, selection mode) and its selection and access handling. It requires Drupal core ^11.4, PHP 8.3+, and Entity Browser ^2. There is no admin settings page and no new entity type or route; configuration lives entirely on a field's Manage form display widget settings.
